name: uTube
subtitle: Native YouTube viewing and commenting
localizedDescription: A personal YouTube client with inline comments and replies, a YouTube inbox, Wall and Carousel Home layouts, AirPlay, background playback, downloads, and customizable controls. Light mode by default. Installs alongside Opaline as its own app; existing Opaline settings and sign-in do not transfer. Maintained by kharrison, based on Opaline by verback2308. For AltStore Classic.
